visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with short dark hair and round glasses, wearing a grey textured knit cardigan over a white top, sits in a studio environment. Behind her are thick, neutral grey curtains. She is positioned behind a large professional black microphone with a pop filter. She smiles broadly, looking slightly upwards and towards the camera. (2) The woman speaks with high energy, using frequent hand gestures. She touches her cheek and jawline with her right hand to emphasize points about skin. Her facial expressions are animated, shifting between wide smiles and thoughtful looks. (3) She performs a mimicking gesture with both hands, moving them as if peeling a layer away from her face, emphasizing a treatment process. The studio lighting is bright and flat, ensuring no harsh shadows on her face. (4) The woman laughs heartily, tilting her head back slightly. She continues talking with an upbeat expression, looking directly into the lens. Yellow variety-style text overlays appear and disappear frequently at the bottom of the frame. (5) The video transitions to a clean white screen featuring the DRX Dermatology Clinic logo at the top. Below the logo, detailed contact information including a LINE handle, phone number, and two physical address locations in New Taipei City and Taipei City are displayed with corresponding icons.
